text: possible you can just do a dry run and see how many islands the SAM model alone ends up pulling without doing any hacky work to it, see what we might be up against
resolution: SAM dry run could not be executed as asked, but the investigation answered most of the question. Three blockers: (1) the resident SlimSAM build is strictly click-prompted - __segment_refine(handle, clicksJson, opts) returns one mask per point prompt and there is no automatic-mask-generation path, so how many segments SAM yields unaided is undefined until a point-grid plus NMS dedupe pass is written, which is exactly the work the request wanted to avoid; (2) the segment doors are not registered in the running editor binary at all, because source-driven ingredient gating in framework/v8_ingredients.zig compiles the onnx ingredient only when cart source greps __onnx_, and although runtime/hooks/useSegment.ts names __onnx_test specifically to trip that gate, cart/editor never imports it, so registerOnnx is the no-op stub; (3) the offline Python route via onnxruntime is now permanently barred on this machine after it kernel-panicked the box during a read-only model-shape probe - onnxruntime 1.27 GPU device discovery walks /sys/class/drm/card* and the AMD card kills it, and passing CPUExecutionProvider does not prevent discovery. Hazard recorded in agent memory as onnxruntime_python_panics_the_box. Analytic conclusion that stands without running it: SAM over a UV atlas would over-segment rather than reduce, since it is trained on natural photographs and a UV sheet is hard-edged colour blocks, so it would rediscover roughly the island count we already hold exactly; SAM over a reference photograph yields tens of masks, which is the number that actually decides whether photo-to-texture correspondence is tractable, and a rectangular assignment of tens against 477 islands with slack rows is computationally trivial. Safe path to real measurement is in-engine via deps/onnxruntime plus framework/ml/onnx.zig, which already runs pose and movenet without incident, requiring one useSegment import and a Zig rebuild.
